# The WORKSPACE signatures of rules_python beside `pip_parse` (design 2.7):
# `multi_pip_parse`, one lock per Python version, and a `pip_parse` under
# `maybe` in the body of a main-repository macro.

=== .bazelversion
7.7.2
=== WORKSPACE
workspace(name = "app")

load("@bazel_tools//tools/build_defs/repo:http.bzl", "http_archive")

http_archive(
    name = "rules_python",
    strip_prefix = "rules_python-0.31.0",
    url = "https://github.com/bazelbuild/rules_python/releases/download/0.31.0/rules_python-0.31.0.tar.gz",
)

load("@rules_python//python:pip.bzl", "multi_pip_parse")

multi_pip_parse(
    name = "pypi",
    default_version = "3.11",
    python_interpreter_target = {
        "3.10": "@python_3_10_host//:python",
        "3.11": "@python_3_11_host//:python",
    },
    requirements_lock = {
        "3.10": "//:requirements_3_10.txt",
        "3.11": "//:requirements_3_11.txt",
    },
)

load("//tools:deps.bzl", "tool_deps")

tool_deps()
=== tools/deps.bzl
load("@bazel_tools//tools/build_defs/repo:utils.bzl", "maybe")
load("@rules_python//python:pip.bzl", "pip_parse")

def tool_deps():
    maybe(pip_parse, name = "tools_pip", requirements_lock = "//tools:requirements.txt")
=== tools/BUILD.bazel

=== requirements_3_10.txt
six==1.16.0
=== requirements_3_11.txt
six==1.16.0
=== tools/requirements.txt
six==1.16.0
